attribute.description: 'price_inr', or a hard rule's attribute such as 'ram_gb'
attribute.title: Attribute

state.description: The state as the filter read it: unknown when verify gave no value, and known for a value disputed in scores only, which the filter checks as an agreed one

values.description: What the filter compared: the price in rupees; a size as a number in `unit`; else the value as its claims gave it. Every side of a disputed value, or every version of a RAM or storage size, claims' first
values.title: Values

unit.description: The numbers' unit: 'INR' for a price, the rule's ('gb'), else None
unit.title: Unit

any_version.description: True when values are the versions the product comes in (DR-02): any one keeping a rule is enough
any_version.title: Any Version

from_names.description: How many of values, the last ones, are versions only the names state; the rest are the claims.
from_names.title: From Names

title: CheckedValue
